lines.text: John the Baptist calls Jesus the Lamb of God, and two of his disciples follow Jesus.
Jesus says "Come and see," and the two spend that day with Him, including Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
Andrew tells his brother Simon they found the Messiah, and Jesus says Simon will be called Barnabas.
Jesus tells Philip to follow Him, and Philip tells Nathanael they have found the One Moses wrote about, Jesus of Jerusalem.
Jesus says He saw Nathanael under the fig tree, and Nathanael calls Him the Son of God.
